summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad transforms in MONAI. Changes: monai/transforms/utility/array.py gains Lambda(Transform) appended at end (asserts callable(func) with message "func must be callable"; call returns func(img)). monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py: typing import now `from typing import Callable, Optional`; Lambda added to vanilla import; Lambdad(MapTransform) added between ConcatItemsd and alias block (super().__init__(keys), self.lambd = Lambda(func), call makes dict(data) copy and applies lambd to each key); alias line `LambdaD = LambdaDict = Lambdad` appended. docs/source/transforms.rst gains Lambda before SplitChannel and Lambdad after ConcatItemsd. New tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py cover identity, slicing (spatial-only), keys view on sole entry, original-untouched, and unlisted-entry preservation. Not run: tests, flake8, black (per instructions); line length and trailing whitespace checked manually. Nothing committed.
